adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 2012 New York, Sitwell and Rumlow's STRIKE team take Loki's scepter to move it for HYDRA. When Steve asks for it, Rumlow refuses, but Sitwell hands it over after Steve whispers "Hail Hydra."
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow HYDRA mole moving the scepter with Rumlow's team in 2012.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The STRIKE leader beside Sitwell as they move the scepter in 2012.
adds.evidence: Time heist at Stark Tower, 2012: Sitwell collects the scepter with the STRIKE team, reports to Pierce in the elevator; Rumlow tells Steve handing it over is not an option; Steve whispers 'Hail Hydra' and Sitwell gives it to him. Wikipedia plot: 'Rogers retrieves the Mind Stone from Hydra sleeper agents.'
